# APIpie AI

APIpie.ai is an AI super aggregator providing a unified API to access a vast array of AI models from leading providers, enabling cost-effective and latency-optimized solutions.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/apipie-ai/.

## Actions

- **Delete Vectors**: Delete an entire vector collection or specific vectors.
- **Fetch model restrictions** (read-only): Retrieve a list of country restrictions for models.
- **Get query history** (read-only): Retrieve historic api usage logs including latency, token counts, costs, and source ip.
- **List AI Models** (read-only): Fetch a list of available ai models.
